title: Wallet of Satoshi lifecycle and Spark self-custody migration
notes: Triggered by a 2026-09-12 user-report signal concerning Wallet of Satoshi balance/receive behavior. That report is discovery material only and is not modeled as a canonical incident event because no high-reliability first-party Wallet of Satoshi or Spark incident statement has been located as of 2026-09-20. This bundle instead stages the missing Wallet of Satoshi entity, its distinct custodial and Spark self-custody product boundaries, the 2019 wallet release record, the 2025 self-custody beta launch, and the 2026 custodial-service deprecation announcement. Candidate IDs are provisional until promotion from fresh main.

entities.summary: Bitcoin Lightning wallet ecosystem that began as a custodial mobile wallet and later added a Spark-powered self-custody wallet while the legacy custodial product entered a phased retirement.
entities.notes: Entity continuity is preserved across the custodial and Spark self-custody products. The two products are separated because their custody and key-management models differ materially.

products.summary: Original custodial Wallet of Satoshi mobile wallet in which Wallet of Satoshi held user funds and account recovery could be assisted by the provider; the product entered a phased retirement in 2026.
products.notes: The current app can expose both legacy custody and self-custody wallet modes. WLR separates them because their custody, recovery, and lifecycle boundaries are materially different.

products.summary: Spark-powered Wallet of Satoshi mobile wallet mode that gives users a 12-word recovery phrase and uses Spark-specific key derivation for self-custodial Bitcoin and Lightning functionality.
products.notes: The product boundary is separate from Wallet of Satoshi Classic because the custody and recovery model changed materially. WLR records the vendor's self-custody description without independently expanding it into claims not stated by the primary sources.

events.title: Wallet of Satoshi beta released for Android and iOS
events.description: Living Room of Satoshi published a Wallet of Satoshi beta release for Android and iOS, documenting the early custodial account-based product and its mobile distribution.
events.notes: The source establishes a dated beta release. The entity launch date remains at year precision rather than assuming this article was necessarily the first public availability.

events.title: Spark-powered self-custody Wallet of Satoshi enters beta
events.description: Wallet of Satoshi and Spark announced a Spark-powered self-custodial Lightning wallet beta, adding a materially different custody and recovery model under the Wallet of Satoshi brand.
events.notes: Spark's dated July 1 announcement establishes the release date; Wallet of Satoshi's own support forum independently describes the private beta and Spark integration.

events.title: Wallet of Satoshi announces phased retirement of custodial wallet
events.description: Wallet of Satoshi announced a phased retirement of the legacy custodial wallet in favor of its self-custody product, with regional restrictions on new custodial invoice creation and a migration period for existing balances.
events.notes: The exact Wallet of Satoshi X post is preserved as primary evidence. Secondary reporting is included only to corroborate the phased-retirement timeline and must not override the primary wording.
